title: rust-lang/rust Rust 1.52.1
summary:
This release disables incremental compilation, unless the user has explicitly opted in via the newly added RUSTC\FORCE\INCREMENTAL=1 environment variable.
This is due to the widespread, and frequently occurring, breakage encountered by Rust users due to newly enabled incremental verification in 1.52

summary:
